messages:
maria_cs: Quick: drafting a tiny customer runtime runbook (day0 health, batching/caching/streaming, renewal flags). Can I get a fast sanity check?

tomi_se: Short thumbs-up. Suggest defaults: warm_pool=3 KV sessions, client_batch_window=5-20ms, stream_chunk=64 tokens. Note: 'sessions' = long-lived KV contexts.

kevin_eng: Add tiny retry + jitter snippet and mention validating prefix caching for PII.

liam_sre: Ops pointers: Console > Observability > Routes for token cost/latency. Quick query: `filter route=="/generate" | stats p50(p95) by tenant`. Alert if p95>SLA+150ms for 72h or error spikes >2x.

ashley_pm: For renewal outreach: if engagement drops >30% while cost per success rises, send a 1:1 with observations, impact, quick fixes, and offer a call.

maria_cs: Thanks all  I'll publish a one-page PDF and add the internal checklist.
